template.name: Landledger: draft variance notes
template.description: When a month's close reaches the notes step, Landledger asks for its variance notes. This flow reads the frozen snapshot and the figures each note may cite, has an AI Agent (a local Ollama model by default) draft one note per cost center citing only those figures, and submits each draft with a key that can do nothing but draft. A draft Landledger refuses for a figure that doesn't match is redrafted once with the refusal, then left to Landledger's template. An analyst accepts every note.

credentials.name: Landledger (read)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with read (the flows' requests key will do): it reads the frozen snapshot.

credentials.name: Landledger (webhooks)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with webhooks:write only: the Landledger Trigger subscribes itself on publish. Or the whsec_ secret of a webhook an admin made.

credentials.name: Landledger (notes:draft)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with notes:draft only: it reads the figures and submits drafts, and can accept nothing.

setup: Pick or add **Landledger (read)** (an `ll_` key with `read`), **Landledger (webhooks)** (`webhooks:write` only) and **Landledger (notes:draft)** (a Landledger Notes Key: `notes:draft` only).

In **Settings**, check `MODEL` and `OLLAMA_URL` (by default `qwen3-coder:30b` on this machine's Ollama, as the cluster reaches it) and, if you like, `SPONSOR` (the person who answers for the drafts; empty: the notes key's minter).
Publish: **Notes requested** subscribes itself to `notes.draft_requested`. When a month's accrual is accepted, Landledger freezes the snapshot and sends it.

Each note: **Draft the note** (the model, citing only the listed figures) → **Submit the draft**. A refusal (a cited figure that differs from the snapshot) → **Redraft with the refusal** → **Submit the redraft**; a second refusal, or a moved snapshot, gives up: the note is left to Landledger's template.
**Landledger note drafts** records every note's outcome. An analyst (FP&A or a controller, never the sponsor) accepts or edits each note in Landledger.

workflow.name: Landledger: draft variance notes
workflow.description: On notes.draft_requested: the frozen snapshot and each note's figures → an AI Agent drafts one note per cost center citing only those figures → submitted with a notes:draft key; a refused draft is redrafted once, then left to Landledger's template.

nodes.name: Notes requested
nodes.notes: Landledger sends notes.draft_requested when the close reaches the notes step (the accrual accepted, the snapshot frozen), once per snapshot.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: The model (MODEL, OLLAMA_URL), the agent Landledger records, its sponsor.

nodes.name: Get the snapshot
nodes.notes: The frozen snapshot, read fresh: the event is not what the drafts trust.

nodes.name: Get the figures
nodes.notes: Each note the month needs, with the figures it may cite and the drivers (service, agent, model).

nodes.name: Draft the note

parameters.systemMessage:
You draft month-end variance notes for Landledger, the company's cost ledger. A finance analyst reviews and accepts every note; you only draft.
Write two to four plain sentences about one cost center: how the month's actual compares with its budget and its day-10 forecast, and what drove the change.
Use only the figures listed under FIGURES, with their amounts exactly as written. Never compute a new number, percentage or total, and write no number that is not one of those amounts.
Answer with JSON only, no prose around it: {"text": "…", "cites": [ … ]}, where cites holds, for every figure the text uses, its line's JSON object from FIGURES copied exactly, unchanged.

nodes.notes: One draft per note, citing only the snapshot's figures. The agent drafts; an analyst accepts in Landledger.

nodes.name: Local model
nodes.notes: The model and Ollama URL come from Settings (MODEL, OLLAMA_URL).

nodes.name: Submit the draft
nodes.notes: Note → Submit Draft with the notes key (notes:draft only). Landledger checks every cited figure against the snapshot: a mismatch is a 422.

parameters.code:
// The notes refused once, in the order the redraft gets them ("Shape the redraft" reads them back by position).
return $input.all();
